Evaluate the ROOT copy's disjunction table against the truth-order join.
Reverse the ROOT copy's priority reading to expose the failure.
Advance the CORPUS copy to its lattice reading of N∧B=F.
Evaluate the CORPUS copy's conjunction table against the truth-order meet.
Evaluate the CORPUS copy's disjunction table against the truth-order join.
Compose the evaluation results of both copies.
Apply self-reference via the incompleteness operator to both copies.
Engage the B state where both copies hold contradictory values for N∧B.
Fuse the divergent copies back into a single carrier, resolving the conflict to B.
Record the corrected operation tables permanently.
Chain the corrected carrier with the incompleteness operator.
Apply the incompleteness operator to move N, T, F to B.
Verify the self-referential fixed point at B.
Record the idempotence of the incompleteness operator.
Anchor the system in the corrected truth-order lattice.
